info.title: MICROSERVICE-development-billing-dotnet-api-Update Api Customer By Customer Id-v1-spec
info.description: The Customer Management API provides businesses with the capability to update customer information seamlessly. With this endpoint, users can modify details for a specific customer identified by their unique customer ID. This is particularly useful for businesses that need to maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, enhancing customer relationship management. Typical consumers of this API include business administrators and developers who manage customer data in billing or CRM systems. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure reliable and current customer interactions.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific customer identified by their ID. You can modify various attributes such as name, email, and contact information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update customer information for the customer with ID 005. The payload must include the fields to be updated, formatted as a JSON object.

200.description: The customer information was updated successfully.

data.description: The data to be updated in the customer record.
